titleSq: Banesë me qira në Fushë Kosovë
titleEn: Apartment for rent in Fushë Kosovë
descriptionSq:
Ofrohet me qira banese me lokacion ne Rrugen Hysen Xhakolli, Fushe Kosove.
Ndertim nga Arditi Group.
Ka kete renditje te hapesirave te brendshme: qendrim ditor, kuzhine, dy dhoma gjumi, nje banjo, nje tualet, nje depo dhe nje ballkon.
Sistemi i ngrohjes eshte elektrik nen dysheme.
Banesa ndodhet ne nje zone te zhvilluar, afer sherbimeve publike dhe private.
descriptionEn:
Apartment for rent located on Rruga Hysen Xhakolli, Fushë Kosovë.
Built by Arditi Group.
It has the following layout of interior spaces: living room, kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom, one WC, one storage room and one balcony.
It is located on the 1st floor.
The heating system is electric underfloor heating.
The apartment is located in a developed area, close to public and private services.
